Terms of Use

FinFlow is a demo

FinFlow demonstrates a private equity workflow using fictional companies, financials, documents, and decisions. Use fictional data only. Do not enter confidential information, personal data, or real deal materials.

Illustrative results

Screening recommendations, AI assessments, valuations, and modeled returns illustrate how the product works. Use them for the demo only. Do not rely on them for an investment or business decision.
